instruction: What is the overall tone of this review?

positive.definition: The review expresses clear satisfaction with the business, highlighting favorable experiences, good service, or high-quality products, and does not contain significant criticism that would outweigh the praise.
examples: Great atmosphere and friendly staff—the food was delicious and worth every penny!
I love this place! The customer service is excellent, and everything is always clean and well-organized.

negative.definition: The review conveys dissatisfaction with the business, focusing on poor service, subpar products, or negative experiences, and the complaints clearly dominate any positive remarks.
examples: Waited over an hour for cold food, and the staff was rude when we complained.
Dirty tables, broken chairs, and the manager refused to help. Never coming back.
